name: minecraft-rcon-panel
description: Web RCON panel for multiple Minecraft servers

scripts.build:launcher: mkdir -p build && cp scripts/mc-rcon-panel.bin build/mc-rcon-panel.bin && chmod +x build/mc-rcon-panel.bin
scripts.build:runtime: rm -rf build/dist build/public build/node_modules && cp -r dist build/dist && cp -r public build/public && cp -r node_modules build/node_modules
scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:auth && npm run build:launcher && npm run build:runtime
